findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 4
Raise: Security. The spec disables project settings but still loads Forge-written user settings, without isolating them from repository commands. A command running as Claude’s user can write an `apiKeyHelper` into that file; the command runner can also supply it an app API key from the sandbox vault. [Anthropic says Claude reloads credential helpers during a session](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings) and [API keys override subscription billing in headless mode](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars). `allowedProviders` limited to Anthropic does not prevent using an Anthropic API key. This is a separate path from the earlier project-settings finding and breaks the promised plan-login boundary without Docker root access.
